newRelationTypes.name: uses-malware
newRelationTypes.definition: The threat actor employs a specific malware family in its malicious operations.

newRelationTypes.name: uses-tool
newRelationTypes.definition: The threat actor utilizes a specific software utility or legitimate tool during operations.

newRelationTypes.name: targeted-country
newRelationTypes.definition: The threat actor conducted cyber operations against entities in the specified country.

newRelationTypes.name: drops-file
newRelationTypes.definition: A file or document extracts and creates a secondary file on the victim's filesystem.

newRelationTypes.name: is-instance-of
newRelationTypes.definition: A specific file is an instance or compiled build of a malware family or software tool.

newRelationTypes.name: drops-payload
newRelationTypes.definition: A malware program unpacks, decrypts, or executes another payload program.

newRelationTypes.name: developed-software
newRelationTypes.definition: An organization or software vendor designed and created a software product.

newRelationTypes.name: has-associated-email
newRelationTypes.definition: An organization or digital certificate is registered with or tied to a specific email address.
